description: The corpus layer: a frontmatter carrying a name, one title first, no empty section, a Checklist after the document's own sections, described with examples, and a token budget each document fits.

outline.description: The items a reviewer verifies before committing a change the rule document governs.
examples:
Before committing code, verify:

- [ ] Every module that logs has exactly one `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` after its imports
- [ ] No logger is stored as `self.logger` or any other instance or class attribute
- [ ] Every log call inside an `except` block uses `logger.exception(...)`

Before committing code, verify:

- [ ] Every public function, method, and `__init__` has annotated parameters and an explicit return type
- [ ] Each `Any` is an opaque third-party value, a `**kwargs` passthrough, or unvalidated input, and the reason is stated
- [ ] An alternative constructor that constructs `cls` returns `Self`
